Hi Priya / Alex — thanks, and totally understood. I put together a first-pass mutual action plan and a gating matrix that maps each milestone to the required legal artifact and approximate review window. High level: 

- Phase A (Eval): PO / NDA already in place — evidence collection & security questionnaire (SOC2 + encryption config) — target completion 09/17.
- Phase B (Pilot): Order Form + Annex A (data handling) required; DPA needs redline pass — target sign 10/20 to hit your 11/01 pilot start.
- Phase C (Prod rollout): MSA signature and long-term order form commitment — separate SLA addendum and activation window (typical 30–45 days after pilot results).

Key risks / blockers: legal wants a single source of truth for the DPA redlines (we can share our template) and procurement needs explicit acceptance criteria for pilot success so they can justify the MSA. I attached: Veridian_MAP_v1.xlsx (milestones + owners), and MSA-DPA-dep_matrix.md (gating matrix).

Next steps: 
1) Quick sync with your procurement + Redwood Legal next week (30 min) — propose Mon 08/17 10:00 PT.
2) If that works, we’ll lock the DPA redline owner and a target turnaround.

Attaching the MAP and a draft order form to make the sequencing explicit.

– Jonas
